facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Poisons: more charges, usable alongside sharpening stones and weightstones, and Malice's crit and Precision's hit apply to them. Warcraft Tavern reports that poison damage scales with Attack Power. Since 16 Oct, poisons no longer proc against targets that are attacking you.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Expose Armor now equals five Sunder Armor stacks and no longer blocks Sunder, so Rogues and Warriors can both add armor reduction.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Utility: Feint's threat reduction is doubled, Sap no longer breaks Stealth, and Distract also lowers enemy stealth detection for 10 seconds while warning enemy players that a Rogue is near.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Rogues can equip one-handed axes, which Blizzard says adds itemization variety.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Precision drops to 3 ranks (up to +3% hit; Classic had 5 ranks for 5%) but now applies to attacks, spells and poisons.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Assassination loses Murder. Venom is now a passive triggered by Shank. Relentless Strikes takes five points, Lethality two, and Seal Fate three.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Combat gains Composure and Flash of Steel. Efficient Strikes discounts Sinister Strike and Hemorrhage. Dual Wield Specialization gives 25% or 50% off-hand damage over two ranks.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Subtlety loses Improved Distract, Quietus, Cutthroat and Thousand Cuts. Quick Getaway helps with Sap, Boot Knife adds combo-point chances to Shank, and Death Mark is the row-7 finisher.

facts.label: Pick Lock training (Level 16)
facts.value: Pick Lock is trained at level 16. Raise Lockpicking early, because the poisons quest needs 80.

facts.label: Poisons quest (Klaven's Tower) (Level 20+ (needs 80 Lockpicking))
facts.value: Alliance chain: Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind, then Agent Kearnen in Westfall, then the tower and the elite Klaven Mortwake; poisons are taught on the Stormwind turn-in. Warcraft Tavern suggests level 22+ or a group. If you pick up Touch of Zanzil, Anti-Venom or Doc Mixilpixil's quest chain clears it.

facts.label: Poison unlocks (Levels 20 to 32)
facts.value: Instant after the questline, Crippling at 20, Mind-numbing at 24, Deadly at 30 and Wound at 32. Poisons skill caps at 5x your level (300 at 60), and reagents come from Shady Dealers.

facts.label: Precision
facts.value: 3 ranks for up to +3% hit, now applying to attacks, spells and poisons.

facts.label: Hit cap at level 60
facts.note: No Blizzard figure, and community estimates conflict.

facts.label: Poison scaling
facts.value: Blizzard increased the attack-power coefficients to 0.009 for Deadly Poison and 0.01 for Instant Poison.

facts.label: Venom
facts.value: Shank increases your poison damage by 30% and your chance to apply poisons by 20% for six seconds.

facts.label: Mutilate
facts.value: A dagger in each hand remains part of the Mutilate setup. The November version moves to row 7 and deals 90% weapon damage plus a higher flat amount.

facts.label: Racials
facts.value: Human Ruthless +1% crit; Dwarf Artisan's Precision +1% hit with spells and attacks (26 Oct).

facts.label: Raid outlook
facts.value: No consensus yet. Warcraft Tavern expects Assassination to do well in most fights and advises Precision for raids.

facts.label: Shank and Venom
facts.value: Shank triggers a six-second increase to poison damage and poison application chance when you have Venom.

facts.label: Expose Armor
facts.value: Now equal to five Sunder Armor stacks and no longer blocks Sunder.

facts.label: Feint
facts.value: Threat reduction doubled in Forever.

facts.label: Onyxia's Lair entry
facts.value: Every raider needs their own Drakefire Amulet in their bags, and Blizzard tells raids to build fire resistance first.

facts.label: Launch raids
facts.value: Barrow Deeps (10 players), Hyjal Summit (20) and Onyxia's Lair (40) open on 9 December 2026, all planned to reset weekly.

facts.label: Poisons with stones
facts.value: Poisons can now be applied alongside sharpening stones or weightstones.

facts.label: Poison supplies
facts.value: Reagents come from Shady Dealers, and Poisons skill caps at 5x your level (300 at 60).

facts.label: Classic melee staples
facts.value: Elixir of the Mongoose, Juju Might, Juju Power, Winterfall Firewater, Free Action Potion, Limited Invulnerability Potion, Grilled Squid and Elemental Sharpening Stone.

facts.label: Food in Forever
facts.value: Grilled Squid now gives +1% crit instead of Agility, and Mightfish Steak gives +40 Attack Power. Icy Veins says both need an Iron Oven camp object (Cooking 300).

facts.label: World buffs in raids
facts.value: Icy Veins' raid overview says world buffs are removed inside raids, and Wowhead's Forever data marks Rallying Cry of the Dragonslayer 'No effect while in a raid instance'.

facts.label: Precision
facts.value: 3 ranks for up to +3% hit, applying to attacks, spells and poisons.

facts.label: Hack and Slash at 5/5
facts.value: Axes and swords: 5% chance of an extra attack. Daggers and fist weapons: +5% crit. Maces: ignore 15% of armor.

facts.label: Weapon Expertise
facts.value: Lowers the chance your attacks are dodged or parried instead of adding weapon skill.

facts.label: Adrenaline Rush
facts.value: Adrenaline Rush increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 seconds, on a 5-minute cooldown. It now requires Blade Flurry.

facts.label: Raid outlook
facts.value: Warcraft Tavern notes Combat is the only Rogue spec with cleave and calls every Rogue spec gear-hungry.

facts.label: Blade Flurry
facts.value: Blade Flurry increases your melee attack speed by 20%, and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby enemy, for 15 seconds.

facts.label: Expose Armor
facts.value: Now equal to five Sunder Armor stacks and no longer blocks Sunder, so Rogues and Warriors can both contribute armor reduction.

facts.label: Launch raids
facts.value: Barrow Deeps (10 players), Hyjal Summit (20) and Onyxia's Lair (40) open on 9 December 2026.

facts.label: Death Mark
facts.value: A row-7 finisher costing 25 Energy, with a 10-second cooldown and a 20-yard range. It stores attack damage for six seconds and counts Garrote and Rupture damage at double rate.

facts.label: Hemorrhage
facts.value: Hemorrhage raises the damage of your Rupture and Garrote by 15%. Blizzard corrected excessive dagger damage for it and Ghostly Strike.

facts.label: Rupture (talentsforever data)
facts.value: Base damage is about 38-42% lower than in Classic.

facts.label: Precision
facts.value: 3 ranks for up to +3% hit, applying to attacks, spells and poisons.

facts.label: Raid outlook
facts.value: Warcraft Tavern says Subtlety now has two PvE builds and that every Rogue spec is gear-hungry.

facts.label: Serrated Blades
facts.value: Serrated Blades makes your attacks ignore 3% of the target's armor and raises Rupture damage by 10% per rank, up to 9% and 30% at rank 3 of 3.

facts.label: Ghostly Strike
facts.value: Your next Ambush or Garrote can skip Stealth if cast within seven seconds after Ghostly Strike.

facts.label: Hack and Slash replaces the weapon specializations
facts.value: Hack and Slash replaces Classic's Sword Specialization, Dagger Specialization, Fist Weapon Specialization and Mace Specialization.

facts.label: Classic Combat talents not in Forever
facts.value: The 10 November talent data has no Improved Backstab, Dagger Specialization, Mace Specialization or Fist Weapon Specialization in the Combat tree.

facts.label: Classic Subtlety talents not in Forever
facts.value: The 10 November talent data has no Sleight of Hand, Improved Sap or Deadliness in the Subtlety tree.

facts.label: Premeditation without Stealth
facts.value: Premeditation no longer requires Stealth; the Classic version did.

facts.label: Warrior matchup: Improved Berserker Rage
facts.value: Improved Berserker Rage at rank 2 of 2 gives the Warrior's Berserker Rage a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects.

facts.label: Warrior matchup: Mortal Strike
facts.value: Mortal Strike reduces the effectiveness of any healing on its target by 50% for 10 sec.

facts.label: Warrior matchup: Improved Hamstring
facts.value: Improved Hamstring gives Hamstring up to a 15% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

facts.label: Warrior matchup: Victory Rush
facts.value: Victory Rush is an instant Warrior strike, usable for 20 seconds after the Warrior kills a non-trivial enemy, that heals 10% of their maximum health.

facts.label: Hunter matchup: traps
facts.value: Hunters can lay traps in combat, and all their traps share one 30-second cooldown.

facts.label: Hunter matchup: Entrapment
facts.value: With Entrapment, every target caught when a Hunter's trap triggers is Entrapped and cannot move for 1 to 5 sec, depending on rank.

facts.label: Hunter matchup: Auto Shot
facts.value: Since 16 Oct, a Hunter's Auto Shot needs about half a second of standing still before it fires.
